rows.input: An X post claimed more Indians will move to Ireland in 2026 than the total number of “babies born to Irish mothers.”

ruling.rating: False. Available Irish data does not support the claim that Indian migration exceeded births to Irish mothers. In 2025, more than 70% newly born babies were registered as Irish and 10% were UK or EU country nationals (excluding Ireland). Although registered nationalities do not necessarily indicate the babies were “born to Irish mothers,” the 2025 statistics clearly indicate that the number of long-term stay visas granted to Indian nationals was much smaller than the proportion of births registered as Irish nationals that year. The statistical trend in 2026 up to August is no different from 2025.
